about: The in-game wiki's layout, in wiki units (the screen's height / 720). Read by the mockup (tools/wiki/mockup/: wiki.js sets every number below as a CSS custom property, which wiki.css lays out with) and by the DLL (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_wikilay.c). tools/wiki/wikilaycheck.py compares the two. A pair is [vertical, horizontal] and a quad [top, right, bottom, left], as in CSS.
roles_about: Each text of the window in the replay HUD's style nearest its role (art/hud/layout.json `styles`): the titles in the stats window's title; a category in the team header; an entry or a demo in a player row's name, a demo's number in the HUD's numbers; the subtitle and the body text in the stats window's foot, its one mixed-case style; the caption, a line written at a moment, in the toast; the controls in the transport's labels; the build menu's buttons and the badge in the stats window's chips; a keycap in a transport button's small label; the build menu's heading and the keys strip's '+' in the HUD's labels.
